response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and strong systems credentials from low-latency, high-throughput DLang microservices at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic. However, modern C++ (or Rust) is the core requirement and his C/C++ experience is brief and dates back to 2014-2015; recent work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js, and there is no direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map tiling pipelines. Worth a conversation only if the team can accept a language ramp-up.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial data experience via GISCollective and Green Map GIS applications
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching) in DLang
Broad full-stack adaptability with proven willingness to learn beyond current expertise
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience is minimal; last C++ role was ~2015 and short-lived
No direct routing, navigation guidance, or tile-generation pipeline experience
Recent career trajectory (TypeScript/Node product work) diverges from systems-level roles
